pages.text: Modifiers use slots and may require earlier levels or specific components. Read the full recipe and the tool’s remaining capacity before applying one.

Prepare industrial modifier components in the appropriate GregTech workshop, then apply them at the required Tinkers station. Choose a few useful abilities that work together rather than filling every slot immediately.$(br2)A good workshop tool: does the job you need, has a repair supply and leaves you with a clear plan for its next upgrade.
